home.title: North Harbor Studio
home.subtitle: We help small businesses build clean websites and clear messaging that bring in better leads.
home.description: From first draft to launch, we turn fuzzy ideas into clear pages that feel premium, load fast, and convert consistently.

services.title: What We Do
services.intro: A focused set of services built for local brands and growing teams that need clarity, speed, and polished presentation.

items.messagingText: Clear headlines and copy that tell people what you do.
items.messagingDetail: We define your value proposition, tone, and page structure so every section feels intentional.
items.designText: Fast, mobile-friendly pages that look professional.
items.designDetail: Modern layouts, conversion-focused hierarchy, and responsive sections that work on every screen size.
items.supportText: Simple monthly updates so your site stays fresh.
items.supportDetail: Content edits, seasonal updates, and performance checks without complicated contracts.

process.title: How We Work
process.intro: Simple process. Fast decisions. Weekly momentum.
process.step1Text: We map your offers, audience, and goals in one short strategy call.
process.step2Text: We craft a polished one-page direction with clear hierarchy and persuasive copy.
process.step3Text: After revisions, we publish, optimize, and hand off with documentation.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.intro: A few words from clients who needed better positioning and a cleaner digital presence.
testimonials.quote1: "Our calls doubled in the first month. The new site finally explains what we offer in plain language."
testimonials.quote2: "Quick, organized, and easy to work with. We launched in a week and the results were immediate."
testimonials.quote3: "The process felt simple from day one. Every section now sounds like us and looks far more credible."
testimonials.quote4: "The one-page format made our offer clearer. Customers now understand our service in less than a minute."
testimonials.quote5: "Great communication and great design taste. They translated our messy draft into something elegant and practical."
testimonials.quote6: "We were surprised by how fast the first version arrived. The revisions were sharp and strategic."
testimonials.quote7: "Our brand finally feels cohesive online. The new page is simple, modern, and easy to update."
testimonials.quote8: "The process removed guesswork. We had clear milestones, clear copy, and a strong launch."
testimonials.quote9: "Professional, friendly, and detail-oriented from start to finish. We now look like a bigger company."
